title: Blocky Stone Doors
description: Add 28+ Stone Doors that can hide in plain sight, identical to normal blocks
body:
Adds 28+ new Stone Doors

This mod Does not add ANY textures, its fully compatible with every texture pack. 

The normal block texture is pulled into the door texture so it will always match




![Stone Door](https://i.imgur.com/Gbl84jT.gif)
